def example(arr):
    if len(arr) <= 1: return arr
    mid = len(arr)//2
    left = example(arr[:mid])
    right = example(arr[mid:])
    res = []
    i = j = 0
    while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
        if left[i] < right[j]:
            res.append(left[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            res.append(right[j])
            j += 1
    res.extend(left[i:])
    res.extend(right[j:])
    return res

def example(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    i = 2
    c = 0
    while i * i <= n:
        c += 1
        i += 1
    return c
